# daterange.parse_range(text) -> (start, end)

Returns a pair of `datetime.date` (or None for an open end). Both ends are inclusive.

1. `A..B`, both ISO dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`): `(A, B)`.
2. `YYYY-MM`: the whole month, first to last day.
3. `YYYY-Www` (ISO week, e.g. `2026-W44`): Monday to Sunday of that ISO week.
4. `YYYY`: the whole year.
5. Open ends: `..B` is `(None, B)`, `A..` is `(A, None)`. `..` alone is an error.
6. `A..B` with B before A is an error.
7. Spaces around the text or around `..` are fine; anything else malformed (bad dates, `2026-13`, `2026-W54`, empty) is an error.

Errors raise `ValueError`.
---

def parse_range(text):
    raise NotImplementedError

_MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})")

        monday = datetime.date.fromisocalendar(year, week, 1)

import datetime
import unittest

from daterange import parse_range


class TestRange(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_range(self, text, start, end):
        self.assertEqual(parse_range(text), (start, end))

    def test_two_dates(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-10-01..2026-10-31",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 31),
        )

    def test_two_dates_with_spaces(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "  2026-10-01  ..  2026-10-31  ",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 31),
        )

    def test_same_start_and_end_date(self):
        day = datetime.date(2026, 10, 1)
        self.assert_range("2026-10-01..2026-10-01", day, day)

    def test_month(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-10",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 31),
        )

    def test_february_in_leap_year(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2024-02",
            datetime.date(2024, 2, 1),
            datetime.date(2024, 2, 29),
        )

    def test_february_in_common_year(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-02",
            datetime.date(2026, 2, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 2, 28),
        )

    def test_iso_week(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-W44",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 26),
            datetime.date(2026, 11, 1),
        )

    def test_iso_week_crossing_year_boundary(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-W01",
            datetime.date(2025, 12, 29),
            datetime.date(2026, 1, 4),
        )

    def test_year(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026",
            datetime.date(2026, 1, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 12, 31),
        )

    def test_open_start(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "..2026-10-31",
            None,
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 31),
        )

    def test_open_end(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-10-01..",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 1),
            None,
        )

    def test_open_ends_with_spaces(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "  ..  2026-10  ",
            None,
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 31),
        )
        self.assert_range(
            "  2026  ..  ",
            datetime.date(2026, 1, 1),
            None,
        )

    def test_period_endpoints_are_expanded(self):
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-10..2026-12",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 12, 31),
        )
        self.assert_range(
            "2026-10-15..2026-11",
            datetime.date(2026, 10, 15),
            datetime.date(2026, 11, 30),
        )
        self.assert_range(
            "2025..2026-W01",
            datetime.date(2025, 1, 1),
            datetime.date(2026, 1, 4),
        )

    def test_reversed_range_is_an_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_range("2026-10-31..2026-10-01")

    def test_reversed_period_range_is_an_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_range("2026-11..2026-10")

    def test_both_ends_open_is_an_error(self):
        for text in ("..", " .. ", "  ..  "):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_range(text)

    def test_malformed_input_is_an_error(self):
        malformed = [
            "",
            "   ",
            "2026-10-01",
            "2026-13",
            "2026-00",
            "2026-02-30",
            "2026-02-29",
            "2026-W00",
            "2026-W54",
            "2026-W1",
            "2026-1",
            "2026-10-1",
            "26-10-01",
            "2026/10/01",
            "not-a-date",
            "2026 - 10 - 01",
            "2026-10-01 . . 2026-10-31",
            "2026-10-01..2026-10-31..2026-11-01",
            "..2026-10-01..",
            "2026-10-01...2026-10-31",
        ]
        for text in malformed:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    parse_range(text)

    def test_non_string_is_an_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_range(None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
